questions.text: In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points in U+0700–U+074F (the Syriac block) are assigned, that is, have a category other than Cn?
How many primes p satisfy 1,035,950 ≤ p ≤ 1,085,617?
Integers are drawn uniformly at random from 1 to 2,529,464, with replacement, until some value appears for the second time. What is the expected number of draws, counting the repeat?
How many lines are in the source file of the standard-library module `statistics` in Python 3.13 (every line, blank or not)?
In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points have the general category Sc (currency symbols)?
Two points are chosen independently and uniformly at random in a 1 × 2.7 rectangle. What is the expected distance between them? (Settled by averaging 400,000 random pairs.)

A simple random walk on the integers starts at 0 and takes 167 steps of +1 or −1, each with probability ½. What is the expected highest position it reaches (0 if it never rises above the start)? (Settled by averaging 4,000 random walks.)
